reason: A DeepSeek Harness web plugin that adds sidebar session-management menus for organizing, renaming, archiving, forking, exporting, and opening conversations or related workspace paths.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页端侧边栏添加会话管理菜单，支持整理、重命名、归档、分叉、导出及打开会话或其工作区路径。
summaries.en: Adds sidebar session-management menus to DeepSeek Harness web for organizing, renaming, archiving, forking, exporting, and opening conversations or their workspace paths.

capabilities: Adds sidebar context-menu and footer UI entries
Pins, marks unread, renames, archives, and forks sessions
Exports sessions and copies session or workspace information to the clipboard
Opens workspace paths in a file explorer and session links in new windows
